title: Dog Music Disc
description: This adds the Dog music disc from the Legacy Console edition
body:
Ever wanted to hear the [Dog Music Disc](https://youtu.be/p02Ww4YrsiM?list=RDp02Ww4YrsiM) in game?  Well here it is! This song played after the [Cat Music Disc](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zi7l20VjQ2I) on Legacy Console Edition.This disc is made by C418 and i did nothing except made the mod.



 Made with MCreator
